title: Fix readiness metadata returned by task creation
description: Decorate a newly created task against the complete task set so a task with unfinished dependencies is returned as blocked and non-claimable. Add provider and CLI regression coverage.

comments.message: Fixed creation-time readiness decoration to use the complete post-create task set. Added provider and CLI JSON regression coverage for unfinished dependencies. Verified with go test ./... (pass).
